purpose: Exact feasibility intersection for one global visibility E-logit threshold per unchanged C45/C46; no threshold/model selection or new fit
scope: Public saved source raw outputs and original synthetic GT/public weak labels only; no current/V169/private/V112/RGB/features/weights/forward/PnP

conditions.native: All original native35 conditions, original mask/limit/N unchanged
conditions.entity_quality: Original fixed0 gates independent and unchanged; not repaired or overridden by visibility feasibility

decision: E iff raw_FP32_as_float64 >= threshold_float64; D iff raw_FP32_as_float64 < threshold_float64; original inputU always U
required_correct: First integer c in 0..N for which Python float(c/N) >= the original stored float limit; do not compute ceil(limit*N)
E_constraint: If at least m valid finite E scores exist, threshold <= m-th largest score (closed upper); otherwise empty
D_constraint: If at least m valid finite D scores exist, threshold > m-th smallest score (open lower); otherwise empty
zero_required: No bound when required correct is zero
intersection: All finite global thresholds satisfying every D and E bound simultaneously; empty if insufficient available support or maximum open lower >= minimum closed upper
report: Report feasibility, exact bound witnesses and immutable bindings. Critical order statistics are feasibility bounds, never selected working points.
